widget:register.what: Allows registering custom widgets on the home grid.
widget:register.chain:
1) App is granted this permission.
2) Widget register API places cards on the home grid.
3) Admin-level; all visitors can see those widgets.
widget:register.frontend: Home widget grid; in-app register/unregister controls.
widget:register.notes: Only install trusted apps — widgets appear site-wide.

platform:read.what: Allows reading existing platform data (games, video, music entries, etc.).
platform:read.chain:
1) App calls platform read APIs.
2) Data comes from configured, synced platforms.
3) Read-only; does not change platform credentials.
platform:read.notes: Unconfigured platforms usually return empty data.

platform:write.what: Allows writing or updating platform data entries.
platform:write.chain:
1) App calls write APIs.
2) Data is stored in site platform storage.
3) Reports / library views that depend on it may change.
platform:write.notes: High impact — bad writes can pollute stats.

platform:register.what: Allows registering a custom platform type on the site.
platform:register.chain:
1) App registers a platform definition.
2) It appears among connectable platforms.
3) Admins can configure and sync that type.
platform:register.notes: Site-level extension; trust the app source.

analytics:read.what: Allows reading aggregated site analytics (visits, top pages, referrers, etc.).
analytics:read.chain:
1) App is granted this permission.
2) Calls Tapp.analytics for summary cards.
3) Aggregate-only — no visitor hashes or raw logs.
analytics:read.frontend: In-app analytics cards; site analytics as the data source.
analytics:read.notes: Read-only aggregates; no backup import/export or AI usage ledgers.

ai:generate.what: Allows AI content generation (text/summaries per site models).
ai:generate.chain:
1) App requests generation.
2) Site AI gateway + quota checks run.
3) Result returns to the app.
ai:generate.frontend: In-app generate actions; AI settings & quotas.
ai:generate.notes: Consumes AI quota; keys/models live in site AI config.

ai:analyze.what: Allows AI analysis of data or structured interpretation.
ai:analyze.chain:
1) App submits content to analyze.
2) Analysis calls consume quota.
3) Insights render in the app.
ai:analyze.notes: Large payloads may be slow or fail.

ai:chat.what: Allows multi-turn AI chat through the site gateway.
ai:chat.chain:
1) App opens a chat session.
2) Messages go through AI chat.
3) History may stay only in the app.
ai:chat.frontend: In-app chat UI (separate from the global Agent panel).

ai:image.chain:
1) App requests an image.
2) Uses the site image model config.
3) Returns image URL/data.
ai:image.notes: Often slower/costlier; image capability must be configured.

ai:search.what: Allows Tapp.ai.tasks.create({ operation: "search" }) for live web search.
ai:search.chain:
1) App submits a query.
2) Host prefers TinyFish Search, else Gemini grounding.
3) Host secrets never enter the sandbox; result is a JSON envelope.
ai:search.frontend: In-app search; site AI permissions and TinyFish key.
ai:search.notes: Delegated separately from ai:generate. Agent Chat still cannot search. Outbound.

3d:generate.what: Allows Tripo to generate, rig, or retarget 3D models (image/multiview → GLB).
3d:generate.chain:
1) App uploads a reference image or model.
2) Host calls Tripo; the API key never enters the sandbox.
3) Persisted GLB returns an asset_id; Tapp.model3d.getUrl loads it in-sandbox.
3d:generate.notes: Spends site Tripo credits; not delegated by default. Reading existing GLBs does not need this permission.

report:read.chain:
1) App requests report content.
2) Reads from report storage.
3) Renders inside the app.
report:read.notes: Does not create reports by itself.

report:write.what: Allows creating, updating, or deleting reports.
report:write.chain:
1) App writes via report APIs.
2) Report list/content changes.
3) Reports page updates.

storage:read.what: Allows reading this app’s private key-value storage (read-only).
storage:read.chain:
1) App calls storage read APIs.
2) Data is isolated per app.
3) Reading never persists writes.
storage:read.frontend: App preferences, drafts, cached state reads.
storage:read.notes: Read-only: never persists writes; do not store secrets in untrusted apps.

storage:write.what: Allows writing to this app’s private key-value storage (write-only, no read).
storage:write.chain:
1) App calls write APIs.
2) Data is isolated per app.
3) Writes affect later app state.
storage:write.frontend: App preferences, drafts, and persistent state.
storage:write.notes: Write access is disabled by default; delegate only to trusted apps.

ui:notification.what: Allows sending system notifications to the user.
ui:notification.chain:
1) App calls notification APIs.
2) Delivery via center / island / toast channels.
3) User preferences still apply.
ui:notification.frontend: Notification center, toasts, browser push if allowed.
ui:notification.notes: Avoid spam; users can mute channels.

ui:fullscreen.chain:
1) App calls fullscreen API.
2) Browser may prompt.
3) User can exit anytime.

ui:theme.what: Allows reading the current site theme for UI matching.
ui:theme.chain:
1) App queries theme APIs.
2) Receives theme tokens.
3) Styles itself; does not change site theme.
ui:theme.frontend: App chrome matching light/dark and accent.
ui:theme.notes: Read-only; change theme in UI settings.

ui:confirm.chain:
1) App requests a confirm box.
2) User accepts or cancels.
3) Result returns to the app.
ui:confirm.frontend: Modal confirms while the app runs.

ui:openUrl.what: Allows the host to open links declared in Manifest openUrls (all other URLs are rejected).
ui:openUrl.chain:
1) App declares openUrls + this permission and is approved at install.
2) Calls Tapp.ui.openUrl({ id }) (optional path/query within match rules).
3) Host checks the allowlist and opens a new tab — no extra confirm dialog.
ui:openUrl.frontend: In-app buttons/cards that open external links; permission copy on the detail page.
ui:openUrl.notes: Only declared links work; sandbox window.open stays disabled. Review declared hosts at install time.

network:fetch.what: Allows declarative HTTP and loading remote media/images.
network:fetch.chain:
1) App declares endpoints or remote assets.
2) Host proxies/validates network access.
3) Response returns to the sandbox.
network:fetch.frontend: External data, covers, media in the app.
network:fetch.notes: Subject to proxy/CORS/security policy; outbound risk.

media:control.what: Allows controlling playback (play, pause, skip, etc.).
media:control.chain:
1) App calls media control APIs.
2) Affects site player state.
3) Control-panel music may update.
media:control.frontend: Global music player; in-app transport controls.
media:control.notes: May interrupt what the user is listening to.

media:read.what: Allows reading current media state (track, progress, playing).
media:read.chain:
1) App queries media state.
2) Read-only session info.
3) Used for lyrics/visualizers.
media:read.notes: Does not change the queue (that is control).

media:audio.what: Allows playing package/blob/data audio inside the sandbox.
media:audio.chain:
1) App starts audio.
2) Only allowed sources play.
3) Not full arbitrary remote control.
media:audio.notes: Different from media:control — focuses on sandboxed sources.

component:theme.what: Allows registering custom theme styles for the site.
component:theme.chain:
1) App registers a theme.
2) Theme list gains an entry.
3) Choosing it changes global look.
component:theme.notes: Site-wide visual impact — trust the source.

component:agent.chain:
1) App registers agent tools.
2) Assistant can invoke them.
3) Chat may trigger those actions.
component:agent.notes: Hooks into the global assistant — very high privilege.

shortcut:register.chain:
1) App declares shortcuts.
2) Keys are handled when focused.
3) App actions fire.
shortcut:register.notes: May conflict with browser or other apps.

event:publish.what: Allows publishing events on the system bus.
event:publish.chain:
1) App publishes an event.
2) Subscribers handle it.
3) Enables cross-module reactions.
event:publish.frontend: UI refreshes / notifications driven by events.
event:publish.notes: Use agreed event names; avoid noise.

event:subscribe.chain:
1) App subscribes.
2) Publishes deliver callbacks.
3) App updates its state.

scheduler:register.chain:
1) App registers jobs.
2) Host fires them on schedule.
3) Jobs use other granted APIs.
scheduler:register.notes: Aggressive schedules waste resources; clean up on uninstall.

speech:tts.chain:
1) App submits text.
2) Site TTS config synthesizes audio.
3) Plays or returns audio.
speech:tts.notes: Needs TTS configured; may use quota.

speech:asr.chain:
1) App captures/uploads audio.
2) ASR service transcribes.
3) Text returns to the app.

tappList:read.what: Allows reading the installed Tapp list and basic metadata.
tappList:read.chain:
1) App queries list APIs.
2) Receives install summaries.
3) Used for display or cross-app flows.
tappList:read.notes: Can reveal which apps you installed.

tappList:manage.what: Allows installing, updating, starting/stopping, or uninstalling Tapps.
tappList:manage.chain:
1) App calls manage APIs.
2) Install state changes.
3) Lists and run state update.
tappList:manage.frontend: Tapp list and detail run/install controls.

brew:read.what: Allows reading Brew sources and articles.
brew:read.chain:
1) App requests Brew data.
2) Reads site subscriptions.
3) Renders reading UI.
brew:read.notes: Read-only; cannot change read state, favorite, or write comments.

brew:write.what: Allows writing Brew data such as read state and stars.
brew:write.chain:
1) App updates item state.
2) Brew storage is changed.
3) Filters and badges may update.
brew:write.notes: Changes your reading state; verify the app behavior before granting.

brew:commentWrite.what: Allows creating, editing, and deleting Brew comments and replies.
brew:commentWrite.chain:
1) App posts comments.
2) Comments attach to articles.
3) Others may see them per policy.
brew:commentWrite.notes: Public expression — follow content norms; delegated by admins only by default.

brew:manage.what: Allows managing Brew sources and advanced settings.
brew:manage.chain:
1) App calls source-management APIs.
2) Subscription set changes.
3) Fetch/list update.
brew:manage.notes: Can add/remove feeds site-wide for Brew.

federation:read.what: Allows reading federation rooms, channels, and members.
federation:read.chain:
1) App queries federation APIs.
2) Returns data allowed by trust policy.
3) Renders federation state.
federation:read.notes: Visibility still limited by trust rules.

federation:post.what: Allows publish/unpublish, creating Notes, uploading media, and managing outbound delivery.
federation:post.chain:
1) App writes federation APIs.
2) Content lands on local and remote instances.
3) Followers see new content.
federation:post.frontend: Posting, media upload, delivery queue management.
federation:post.notes: Posts sync to remote instances — grant carefully.

federation:interact.what: Allows follow/unfollow, like/unlike, bookmark/unbookmark, and announce/unannounce.
federation:interact.chain:
1) App performs interactions.
2) Interaction is stored and broadcast to authors.
3) Authors see the result.
federation:interact.frontend: Follow, like, bookmark, and boost entry points.
federation:interact.notes: Interactions broadcast to other users; a durable login is required.

federation:channel.what: Allows creating, accepting, closing, deleting channels and channel E2E key setup.
federation:channel.chain:
1) App creates/governs channels.
2) Channel structure and key state change.
3) Members see channel updates.
federation:channel.notes: Channel governance syncs to remote instances.

federation:room.what: Allows create/update/delete rooms, join/invite, member governance, E2E keys, stickers and pins.
federation:room.chain:
1) App operates on rooms.
2) Room structure and membership change.
3) Members see room updates.
federation:room.frontend: Room create, join, member and governance screens.
federation:room.notes: Room governance syncs to remote instances.

federation:ring.what: Allows Ring membership management and peer/sync operations.
federation:ring.chain:
1) App manages ring members and peers.
2) Ring membership and sync state change.
3) Remote peers receive sync.
federation:ring.frontend: Ring management, peer lists and sync triggers.
federation:ring.notes: Ring sync pushes data to remote peers.

federation:message.what: Allows sending and receiving federation messages.
federation:message.chain:
1) App sends/receives messages.
2) Delivery queue handles transport.
3) Peers may receive content.
federation:message.notes: Content can leave the site — privacy/abuse risk.

federation:trust.chain:
1) App adjusts trust policy.
2) Affects accept/reject of peers.
3) Filtering and delivery change.
federation:trust.notes: Misconfig can break federation or trust bad peers.

federation:files.chain:
1) App uses file APIs.
2) Files go through federation file channel.
3) Arrive remotely or download locally.
federation:files.notes: Size/type limits may apply; malware risk.

game:session.what: Allows creating and joining federation game rooms and exchanging structured game messages.
game:session.chain:
1) App calls Tapp.game.
2) Host sends game:<tappId>:<protocol> envelopes on a room.
3) Members on this or a peer instance receive intent/state.
game:session.frontend: Game lobby, share room_id@home_server, match sync.
game:session.notes: Federation read/write/message are still required. Authority stays with the host client.
